title: Chicken Pillows
creator: Katerina Poulos Stuckey
instructions: Mix shredded chicken with cream cheese, cheddar cheese, and chopped green onion.
Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into triangles.
Place a spoonful of chicken mixture at the wide end of each crescent triangle.
Roll up the crescent dough around the filling, tucking edges to form a pillow shape.
Prepare egg wash by beating egg with a splash of milk.
Crush crackers into fine crumbs for breading.
Dip each chicken pillow in egg wash, then coat with cracker crumbs.
Bake until golden brown (temperature and time visible in video).
For gravy: heat cream of chicken soup with chicken bouillon until smooth and warmed through.
Serve chicken pillows with cream of chicken gravy.
notes: Recipe by Katerina Poulos Stuckey. Full technique visible in video. Ingredient list confirmed by creator in first comment. Tips from comments: garlic can be added to the filling; crescent roll pizza crust can substitute for regular crescent rolls; crush garlic parm croutons for extra flavor in the breading. Variation: use hamburger meat with cheddar cheese ragu sauce instead of chicken for 'bacon cheeseburger pillows', with dill pickle potato chips as breading.
